capabilities: Build a GraphRAG-style index of vault notes with embeddings, an entity graph, and community reports
Propose cleanup edits for the open note via a review diff
Suggest placement for inbox notes without moving files automatically
Answer vault questions with cited sources from the index
Summarize the whole vault into a one-page summary card
disambiguation: The name suggests generic vault upkeep tools, but its work is LLM agents that only propose edits, placements, and answers for your review.
extras: Author warns the plugin is unsafe for vaults you cannot lose; index builds can consume ~10x the index file size in RAM; all writes are confined to the vault and .note-maintainer/ can be gitignored with one rule.
problem: Keeping a growing vault tidy and findable takes manual cleanup, inbox triage, and searching, and Obsidian has no built-in AI assistant for these tasks.

relations.evidence: The indexer and agents speak to any OpenAI-compatible API:
relations.plugin: OpenAI-compatible APIs (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio)

requires.name: local LLM server (Ollama, LM Studio, OMLX, vLLM)

summary: LLM assistant that builds a GraphRAG-style index of the vault and uses agents to clean notes, sort the inbox, and answer questions with cited sources.
